Focus  $SOXX  via  $SOXL  3x Long (Bullish Flag)
Upgrading to Focus today from yesterday's Stalk status. Got the compressed print beneath pivotal level for an ideal entry. ETF based ideas don't require RVOL but i will highly encourage you to sit out the first 30mins for the opening volatiltiy and widen spread to settle first

Focus  $XLK  via  $TECL  3x Long (Relative Strength Sector)
Alongside with  $SOXX ,  $XLK  has also been upgraded to Focus idea for potential execution today. Current pre-market is already gapping to 3-month high, just about clearing the past 7 sideway box range. As highlighted yesterday I am still with 66% size left from Sept 21st entry on  $TECL  so this is an area for potential add. Let it settle the first 30min first but i will not execute it beyond 4.5 x ATR% from 50-MA.

Focus  $DRAM  via  $RAM  2x Long (DTL but above all MA, RS 80%)
Among the 3 Focus ETF ideas listed today ( $SOXX ,  $XLK ,  $DRAM ), this will be the least of my priority. Lower low print and pre-market price now just barely reclaim yesterday's high (my white line alert is based on tuesday high for strength). Still a viable idea for entry considering the price action presents a structural setup, RS 80% group, ATR% from 50-MA is only 1.8. Also a trading idea to get ahead of mega cap memory stocks earnings before 3rd and 4th week of October eg.  $SNDK  29th Oct AH

Focus  $FRSH  (Pre-Market Gapper, but needs to fill gap first)
Current pre-market price hovers above the box range highlighted but there's still a Sept 4th gap down resistance to challenge. The optimal scenario is for opening session to fill the gap and stall, before it ORH again at less than 70% LoD with RVOL as high as 30% within the first 30mins session.

Focus  $WDAY  (Pre-Market Gapper Into PEG Print)
2 days of higher lows surfing on its rising 50-MA. current pre-market price is a gap above the coiling of 10 and 20-MA. It is also gapping back into August 28th post earning day print. Volume has contract and been low since (ignore Sept 18th option expiration friday's volume spike)
Will need RVOL above 20% within first 30mins of session before any consideration for execution.

Stalk  $SEI  (Pre-Market Gapper but Miniscule Volume)
Last 3 days print is structured but still remains too wide for my liking. Sharing here to see how it develops. If it fail the breakout today, the near term reset may present a better entry opportunity.

Focus  $SKHY  (Ascending Trendline)
2 days higher low action on its rising 20-MA. Has a Sept 28th gap resistance to fill as per my white line (ideal execution level). Don't need RVOL so such heavily liquid name (avg dollar vol is $3.9B) but will hold off the first 30mins, similar to ETF based ideas. Between  $SKHY  and  $RAM , i will choose the higher ADR% idea for lower capital outlay.  $HYNX  2x long may be 7.8% ADR but may be a little illiquid at avg 830k shares volume. Do check the bid-ask spread during execution.

Focus  $ALAB  via  $LABX  2x Long (Bullish Flag)
Another stalk idea gets an upgrade to Focus today. Good to have  $MU  earnings out of the way to avoid any risk of sympathy gap down move.

Focus  $SNDK  via  $SNXX  2x Long (Ascending Trend Line Support)
Similar idea to  $SKHY  but definitely prefer this for its liquidity and  $SNXX  10% ADR availability. Don't need RVOL but need to be patient to hold off any trigger in the first 30mins.

Focus  $CRSR  (Sideway Box Range)
The current sideway box range is so tight that it's within less than 1 ATR since Sept 17th.  $CRSR  is probably the lowest market cap and lowest average $ vol idea I have ever shared but this is a very clean VCP idea that high RVOL can be identified very easily. Looking for 25% RVOL within 30mins of open.

Focus  $MU  via  $MUU  (Post Earnings)
Immediate post earnings idea on this potential gap down open. But there's every possibility that it can flip up and break the highlighted white line range with substantial volume. On that basis, the execution presented may be <70% LoD. Wait 30mins.
